name: io.github.Servosity/knowbe4-mcp
title: KnowBe4 MCP
description: Every KnowBe4 KMSAT reporting feature plus a local SQLite store that answers the cross-client

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the KNOWBE4_API_KEY credential for the KnowBe4 MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from KNOWBE4_REGION. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Set the KNOWBE4_REGION credential for the KnowBe4 MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Separate bearer key for the KnowBe4 User Events API, which has its own host and key. Needed only for the `events` commands; leave blank otherwise.
